personas.name: Satisfied User
personas.description: A user who consistently uses the Calm app in their daily routine for meditation, sleep, and relaxation.
goals: Easily maintain a daily routine for meditation, sleep, and relaxation.
Access high quality mediatation, sleep, and relaxation content.
pain_points: Preffered narrator's can change without any notice.
context: Frequently uses the app to make their routine more convenient and accessible.
Values and prefers certain narratos over other for meditation sessions.
constraints: Audio content including specific narrators must be available consistently.
Features must not be pay walled without proper and explicit communication with users.
personas.notes: The automated persona for the first group only containted keywords, so I refined this persona to reflect satisified app users.

personas.name: Poor Sleeper
personas.description: User wo struggles with sleeping and relies on Calm's sleep stories and calming audio content.
goals: Improve sleep quality and fall asleep faster using sleep stories and relaxing audio.
Have access to a wide variety of sleep audio content.
pain_points: Lack of variety in terms of narrator voice selection.
App crashes during overnight sessions where it is open for multiple hours.
context: User consistently uses the app to fall asleep.
Finds sleep stories calming and environmental sounds relaxing.
constraints: Audio must not be interrupted for at least 8 hours.
Audio content for sleep session must have a large variety of narrators and environmental noises.
personas.notes: Automated persona had a lot of problems including empty goals, pain points, etc., basically had to refine the entirety of this persona from the corresponding review group.

personas.name: Mental Wellness Improvement Seeker
personas.description: A causal user who wants to find ways to improve their mental wellness through the means of meditating, where they expect the app should be intuitive to navigate and use.
goals: Quickly find and start meditation sessions without too much set up.
Find new content easily through a simple UI.
pain_points: Background audio drowns out the narrator's voice during some sessions.
context: Relatively new to the app and do not use it everyday.
Has little or no experience with meditation and is reliant on the app.
constraints: Search functions must be accurate and return results quickly.
Navigation must be as simple as possible with the least amount of user input needed to find or start something.
personas.notes: Automated persona was way too broad.  I had to refine it by narrowing it down to usability and content discovery.

personas.name: Frusterated Free to Use Individual
personas.description: A user who was looking for free options to use for guided meditations but is frusterated with how many features are pay walled.
goals: Get use out of core app features before deciding on upgrading to a payed subscription.
pain_points: Most of the useful features/content is pay walled.
Free trial period is not long enough to get a meaningful and lasting experience from the app.
context: Recently downloaded the app without subscribing to see if it is worth paying for.
Looking at various meditation/mental wellness apps.
constraints: Free trial must provide enough content for a real assessment of the app to properly compare against other similar apps.
Trials terms and feature limitations must be explcitly communicated before sign-up.
personas.notes: Refined the automated persona by adding the missing fields.  Modeled after the group who are frusterated with free tier accessibility.

personas.name: Wrongfully Charged Subscriber
personas.description: A user who was charged for a subscription unexpectedly after cancelling or letting their free trial end.
goals: Get a refund for the wrongful and un-desired charge.
Easily cancel subscriptions and free trials with little to no effort.
pain_points: Charged during the free trial period.
Customer support is unwilling to give out refunds and are unhelpful with billing issues.
context: Cancelled a free trial or subscription but still charged.
Attempted to contact customer support to no avail.
constraints: Cancellation must ensure no charge will occur in the future.
Refund leniency must be higher and payments must be timely.
personas.notes: Automated persona again had empty fields.  Based this refinement of the persona around users who get wrongfully charged for a subscription.
